This constant comes from nghttp2's HTTP/2 Rapid Reset (CVE-2023-44487) mitigation, added in v1.57.0, which rate-limits incoming RST_STREAM frames with a token bucket (burst + refill rate). From memory of the source, the internal defaults in `lib/nghttp2_session.c` are a burst of 250 (and a refill rate of 250/sec), matching the documented defaults for `nghttp2_option_set_stream_reset_burst`/`_rate` (which replaced the deprecated `nghttp2_option_set_stream_reset_rate_limit`). I can't verify against the tree (offline, no source here), but I'm fairly confident in 250 rather than guessing an alternative.

ANSWER: 250
